Prompt details below

title: 「……決まったでしょ？👁️🐻」
text:
「……決まったでしょ？👁️🐻」
「どこが！？🤣」

30sの遊びは、15s遊びより2倍楽しい。
そして負担も2倍🥹

@capcutapp_jp 
#CapCutCPP #CapCut生成AI

Seedance 2.5 Prompt:📷⬇️

【参照画像】を30秒間の唯一の主人公＋ベア参照として固定使用する。Seedance 2.5向け、16:9・30秒・60fps。映像全体を一本の連続した超高速AAAファンタジー・シネマティックとして生成する。今回の映像は前作の「高高度から地下へ落下し続ける構造」を使用せず、舞台、進行方向、生物、映像展開を全面的に変更する。核は「主人公とベアが巨大な異世界都市を逃げ回り、飛び、乗り換え、世界そのものを横断する30秒」。主人公とベアは常に一本の運動線上で移動し、通常編集カット、暗転、フェード、突然の場所変更、ポータル、ワープ穴は禁止。カメラは主人公の横を追うだけではなく、正面迎撃、背面追跡、頭上越し、地面すれすれ、巨大生物の翼下、主人公とベアの間、狭い建築物内部などを高速で行き来し、30秒間ほぼ同じ位置に留まらない。

【最重要：参照画像のAAA化】 【参照画像】の主人公を、写実人間や通常の美少女へ置換せず、参照画像固有の「一つ目の異形キャラクター」として最高品質AAA 3Dキャラクターへ再構築する。成人女性として扱うが、人間の顔へ矯正しない。顔中央に存在する巨大な一つ目、白い眼球、紫〜青〜赤の虹彩、黒い瞳孔、非常に大きな歯を見せる特徴的な笑顔を完全維持。目を二つに増やさない。普通の人間顔にしない。赤〜深いワイン色の丸いヘルメット、黒い縁、ヘルメット上の黒い小さな丸装飾、黒いボディスーツ／ジャケット、白い骨格モチーフ、赤いコード状装飾、黒いボリュームのある下衣装、濃紺〜黒の靴を参照画像から取得する。水彩の赤、青、紫、緑、黒の色ムラは消さず、AAA化した素材表面へ手塗り染料、擦れた顔料、微細な色移りとして残す。皮膚をリアルな人間肌にし過ぎず、実在素材感を持つ高品質stylized AAA characterとして処理する。表面には細かな粗さ、塗装ムラ、縫製、金属、ゴム、布、革、微細な傷を持たせる。参照画像の黒いインク輪郭は完全な2D線として残さず、衣装の黒い縁取り、ヘルメットの厚いエッジ、陰影の輪郭設計へ3D的に翻訳する。ゲーム画面のような安いCGにはしない。Unreal Engine級AAAシネマティック、長編アニメ映画級の材質、GI、反射、体積光、レンズ表現を使う。

【ベア固定】 【参照画像】で主人公が抱えているピンク〜紫系のベアを、今回は主人公と並ぶ第二キャラクターとして30秒間常時維持する。単なるぬいぐるみではなく、主人公と会話し、自分で走り、自分で空を飛び、主人公と同速度で移動できる小型の生きたベア。参照画像の丸い耳、黒い目、黒い鼻、白〜クリーム色の口周り、ピンク、紫、青、緑、淡黄色が水彩のように混ざる身体、縫い目、柔らかな丸い手足を維持する。AAA化では高級ぬいぐるみ＋幻想生物の中間。短く柔らかな繊維、縫い糸、少し擦れた布地、柔らかい圧縮変形、耳や手足の慣性を表現する。ベアは主人公のコピーでもペットでもなく、少し生意気な相棒。主人公と別の声を持つ。主人公とベアのサイズ差を維持し、ベアを巨大化させない。主人公が必要な場面では片腕で抱えることができる大きさ。

【舞台】 開始地点は、夕暮れの巨大な「浮遊メガシティ」。普通のビル街ではなく、赤錆色の巨大鉄骨、ガラスの高架回廊、空中を走る磁気列車、上下逆向きに建つ建築群、巨大風車、浮遊広告板のフレームだけが残る廃未来都市、雲を突き抜ける高層塔、遠方で回転する巨大なリング状都市構造を持つ。色は夕焼けのオレンジ、深い群青、赤紫、冷たいシアン。過剰なネオンは禁止。すべて最高品質AAA 3Dシネマティック。後半では都市→雲海→空中水路→巨大ガラス森林→夜の浮遊市場へ連続移動するが、どれも突然切り替えない。建築物、天候、生物、地形の物理的な連続によって次の領域へ入る。

【カメラ基本設計】 18〜24mm広角を高速移動の基本とし、会話や表情では28〜40mmへ自然に寄せる。60fps。カメラはドローンのように平行追跡し続けない。0.4〜1.2秒ごとに高さ、距離、角度、速度を変える。主人公とベアの前を後退→主人公の肩すれすれを通過→ベアの下を潜る→巨大生物より先に進む→正面へ回る→地面すれすれで後退→建築の穴を先に通り抜ける、といった三次元移動を連続させる。意味のない360度ロールは禁止。ただし巨大生物の旋回、重力方向変化、建築物の曲面に合わせた短い15〜70度のバンクは積極的に使う。高速運動部分だけ自然な方向性モーションブラーを入れ、主人公の一つ目、笑顔、ベアの表情は読める程度に保持する。

【0.00〜3.20秒｜いきなり空中列車の屋根を全力疾走】 第1フレームから強烈な速度。主人公とベアは、夕暮れの浮遊都市を時速数百kmで走る黒い磁気列車の屋根を全力疾走している。主人公が前、ベアが1〜2m後ろを短い脚で必死に走る。主人公の赤いコード、黒い衣装、ヘルメット装飾が風圧で揺れ、ベアの耳と腕が激しく後方へ流れる。開始カメラは列車前方約4m、屋根すれすれ20mmで後退しながら二人を正面から捉える。0.5秒でカメラが主人公の足元へ急降下し、列車屋根の金属継ぎ目がレンズ下を猛烈に流れる。0.9秒で主人公の右脚の外側から一気に上昇し、巨大な一つ目と歯を見せる笑顔へ24mmで接近。主人公は走りながら振り返り、後ろのベアへ「遅いよ〜！」と楽しそうに叫ぶ。ベアは息を切らしながら「脚の長さ考えてよ！」と返す。完全リップシンク。1.5秒、前方に途切れたレールと巨大な空中ギャップが見える。主人公は速度を落とさず「じゃ、飛ぶよ！」。ベアが「聞いてない！」。2.3秒、主人公が列車屋根を蹴り、ベアも直後にジャンプ。カメラは二人の間を高速ですり抜け、そのまま先に空中へ飛び出して振り返り、背後から迫る主人公とベアを正面から受ける。

【会話・声】 主人公は成人女性。少し低めで明るく、いたずら好き、テンションが高くても甲高すぎない。ベアは小型キャラクターらしい少し高めの声だが幼児声にしない。声質を混同しない。指定セリフ以外を勝手に追加しない。同じ台詞を複数回発声しない。口の動きと完全同期。高速アクション中も会話のたびに主人公やベアを停止させない。セリフ：「遅いよ〜！」「脚の長さ考えてよ！」「じゃ、飛ぶよ！」「聞いてない！」「最初から抱えててよ！」「それじゃ面白くないじゃん！」「え、そこ入るの？」「絶対入る顔してる！」「ありがと！」「ぼく泳げないんだけど！」「浮いてるから大丈夫！」「次、あそこ！」「次って何！？」「考えてない！」「知ってた！」「ちょっと待って、ぼくも飛べる気がする！」「今！？」「飛べた！」「危なっ！」「速い速い！」「さっきもっと速くって言ってたでしょ！」「これは速すぎ！」「ねえ、そろそろ目的地どこ？」「目的地？……ないよ？」「最後、飛ぶよ！」「それ今日何回目！？」「完璧〜！ ……って、ベアどこ？」「完璧じゃなーーい！」「うそっ！」「……決まったでしょ？」「どこが！？」。

【音楽・SFX】 音楽はhigh-speed quirky cinematic electro × orchestral breakbeat。135〜145 BPM程度。低域はタイト、軽快なドラム、短いブラス、弦のスタッカート、木管のコミカルなアクセント、clean sub、digital percussion、短いシンセ。重いEDM dropは禁止。列車屋根では金属振動と強風、ジャンプ時は空気圧、白鴉は巨大翼の羽ばたきと羽根の風切り、空中水路では水圧、泡、低い共鳴、天空鯉では水膜と巨大尾の振動、ガラス森林では透明枝の高い共鳴音、角兎では巨大な足音、毛の擦れ、地面振動、浮遊市場では布、木、金属、遠い群衆の環境音、時計塔では巨大歯車の金属噛み合わせを入れる。会話がある瞬間だけ音楽を不自然に止めず、1〜2dB程度自然に下げて声を前へ出す。最後の「どこが！？」直前に音楽を0.15秒だけ抜き、セリフ後に短いコミカルな打楽器アクセント。笑い声は自然に残す。

【絶対優先事項】 【参照画像】の主人公をAAA化しても一つ目、巨大な笑顔、ヘルメット、黒い骨格モチーフ衣装、赤いコード、色彩を維持。二つ目の普通の女性へ変えない。ベアも【参照画像】のデザインを維持し、新規の相棒キャラクターとして常に同一個体。主人公とベアを30秒間別キャラクターへ置換しない。映像全体は最高品質AAAシネマティックで統一し、途中で実写、2Dアニメ、水彩へ質感変更しない。今回の魅力は質感変化ではなく、異常なカメラ運動、場所変化、乗り換え、主人公とベアの掛け合いに置く。都市→空中水路→ガラス森林→草原→浮遊市場の変化はすべて実際の移動で成立させる。登場大型生物は巨大白銀鴉、天空鯉、巨大角兎。ドラゴン、マンタ、グリフォンは今回登場させない。主人公とベアは動物を道具として扱わず、乗り換え時に短く触れたり撫でたりして自然な交流を持たせる。主人公とベアが一緒に走る、一緒に落ちる、一緒に乗る、ベアが自力飛行する、並んで会話する、最後に主人公がベアを助けるという関係性を30秒の中で明確に見せる。

【禁止】 主人公の二つ目化、普通の人間顔化、一つ目消失、ヘルメット消失、黒い衣装消失、骨格模様消失、赤いコード消失、参照画像と無関係な美少女化、ベアの別デザイン化、ベア巨大化、ベア消失、主人公複製、ベア複製、追加人間主人公、子供化、老人化、顔変更、衣装変更、余分な腕、余分な脚、6本指、融合した指、身体ねじれ、関節破綻、低品質ゲームCG、プラスチック質感、安価なトゥーンシェーダー、2D化、実写化、途中の映像媒体変更、通常編集カット、暗転、フェード、ワープ、ポータル、魔法陣、意味のない発光ゲート、巨大爆発、レーザー、過剰な火花、画面を覆う粒子、常時Bloom、白飛び、読める文字、字幕、UI、ロゴ、広告、意味のない360度回転、長時間の横固定カメラ、低速歩行、停止ポーズ、スローモーション、主人公だけが自由飛行する表現、乗り物や生物が突然出現する表現、ドラゴン、巨大マンタ、グリフォンの再使用、最後の黒フェードを禁止する。

title: Seedance 2.5 vs Seedance 2.0
text:
Seedance 2.5 vs Seedance 2.0.

Seedance 2.5 is way ahead of the industry.

Full prompt:
**[SCENE]** A two-member female pop duo shoots a retro Y2K-style music video: candy-colored studio sets, tightly synchronized hand choreography, beat-locked hard cuts and fast punch zooms — the texture of 1999 music television, rendered at modern production quality.

**[ACTIVE REFERENCES]**
<<<image_1>>>: Female singer in her twenties, long straight pink hair with gold hair clips, small nose ring, beauty mark on cheek, white printed crop top, silver chain necklace, chain belt, light-blue washed baggy jeans, off-white platform sneakers. Playful and confident. 100% match to reference image.
<<<image_2>>>: Female singer in her twenties, long straight black hair with silver hair clips, light blue eyes with silver glitter eyeshadow, red cord necklace with ruby pendant, gray raglan short-sleeve tee with a gray jacket draped over the shoulders, dark gray pleated skirt with bow, gray knee socks, black platform shoes. Cool and commanding. 100% match to reference image.

**[SET MAP]** Three practical studio sets, each roughly 4 meters deep, facing camera:
Set A — bubblegum-pink seamless cyclorama, glossy reflective floor, two rows of round studio light bulbs on the back wall.
Set B — cobalt-blue seamless cyclorama, a single hard white spotlight circle on the floor.
Set C — floor-to-ceiling silver rain-strand curtain wall, mirrored floor.

**[FIRST FRAME & SPATIAL LAYOUT]** The first visible frame already contains both girls, on Set A: <<<image_1>>> at frame-left x40%, <<<image_2>>> at right x60%, medium-shot depth, 0.5 m apart, bodies squared to camera, eyes locked on lens, frozen in a mirrored opening pose — inner hand on hip, outer arm raised. No empty establishing shot, no delayed entrance.

**[FORMAT]** Controlled multi-shot sequence, seven segments across 15 seconds, every hard cut landing precisely on a musical downbeat. Real-time motion.

**[LENS NOTES]** Fisheye = true fisheye wide-angle, 1.5 m from subject, visible barrel distortion at frame edges, deliberate 1999 MV lens language; 47° = standard view, natural proportions; 29° = medium-tele portrait, background lightly compressed; 18° = long-lens close-up, melted bokeh. Locked within each segment, no drift.

**[ACTION TIMELINE]**
0.0–2.0s Set A, fisheye low angle: both hit the frozen mirrored pose on beat one, then bounce-groove in sync with every beat, camera slowly pushes in 10%.
Hard cut at 2.0s. 2.0–4.0s Set B, 29°: <<<image_2>>> solo dance inside the spotlight circle at x50%, pointed-at-camera precision hand choreography, one fast punch zoom landing exactly on the downbeat.
Hard cut at 4.0s. 4.0–6.0s Set C, 47°: <<<image_1>>> whips her pink hair through a full arc, then strides toward camera as the camera pulls back at matched speed, rain-strand curtain shimmering, chain belt swinging.
Hard cut at 6.0s. 6.0–8.0s Set B, 18° two-shot close-up: both faces cheek-to-cheek filling the frame, <<<image_1>>> left / <<<image_2>>> right, soft wind lifting pink and black strands, glossy makeup, confident smiles, heads tilting toward each other in sync with the beat.
Hard cut at 8.0s. 8.0–11.0s Set A, 47° full body: the chorus dance core — three counts of fully synchronized choreography: wave arms, fast spin, full-body groove into a sharp freeze; positions cross and return, <<<image_1>>> left / <<<image_2>>> right re-locked.
Hard cut at 11.0s. 11.0–13.0s Set C, 47°: the two walk toward camera side by side with synchronized arm swings, black and pink hair swinging with each step, reflections in the mirrored floor.
Hard cut at 13.0s. 13.0–15.0s Set A, 47°: back-to-back frozen final pose, camera zooms out fast to full body, landing exactly on the last downbeat, one bright camera-flash white sweep over the final frame.

**[PHYSICS]** Choreography carries real weight: heel strikes, weight shifts, shoulder isolations with follow-through. Hair whips show visible lag and settle naturally. Chain belt and necklaces swing on the beat points. Rain-strand curtain ripples from body movement. Glossy floor returns soft, believable reflections.

**[LIGHTING]** High-key, even studio lighting on every set: large soft frontal key, bright clean exposure, high skin sheen; Set A's bulb rows create back rim light and soft bloom into the lens; Set B's spotlight casts a crisp circular pool; Set C sparkles with hundreds of rain-strand specular highlights. Bright, candy-like, camera-ready — a deliberate flat 1999 broadcast-TV look.

**[AUDIO]** Original Y2K bubblegum dance-pop instrumental, 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, bright syncopated synths, faint tape hiss underneath. Every hard cut lands exactly on a downbeat. Instrumental only throughout, no vocals; both girls perform with closed lips, delivering energy purely through expression and choreography.

**[POSITIVE LOCKS]** Both faces and identities 100% locked to reference images across all segments including close-ups. Wardrobe stays exactly as referenced across all three sets. Only these two girls appear in the entire video. In every two-person segment <<<image_1>>> is fixed frame-left, <<<image_2>>> fixed frame-right. Within each segment, set geography, spacing, and screen direction stay consistent.

**[STYLE]** Shot at modern production quality but graded to 1999 broadcast texture: broadcast-grade videotape master grain layered over high-detail imagery — soft highlight bloom, slight chroma bleed on hard color edges, fine analog tape grain, faint interlace flicker on fast motion; a high-saturation candy palette of bubblegum pink, electric cobalt and chrome silver; Y2K music-television punch-zoom editing energy, with contemporary sharpness preserved underneath.

text:

Prompt :

A realistic UGC-style from  lifestyle grocery shopping vlog filmed vertically on a smartphone with natural handheld movement and subtle camera shake. The video opens with the young woman entering a modern premium organic grocery store with warm ambient lighting, clean wooden shelves, fresh produce, and a bright minimalist interior. She holds the phone in selfie mode, smiles naturally, and gestures for viewers to follow her. She walks toward the refrigerated drinks section, scans the shelves, and picks up a green cold-pressed juice bottle, turning it slowly so the label faces the camera. Cut to a cinematic close-up as she twists the cap open and takes a refreshing sip beside a large sunlit window, smiling with a satisfied expression. Transition to a POV shot from inside a shopping cart as she pushes it through wide grocery aisles, occasionally looking down into the cart and smiling. Follow with an over-the-shoulder walking shot through beautifully organized shelves filled with premium groceries. Close-up of her hand selecting fresh oranges, gently inspecting one before placing it into the cart. End with a close-up of her picking up a vibrant dragon fruit, rotating it naturally in her hand while admiring its color before placing it into the cart. Finish with her walking toward the checkout while smiling at the camera, pushing the cart under warm golden lighting.

Ultra-realistic, authentic creator content, premium grocery aesthetic, natural body language, realistic facial expressions, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth transitions, realistic store ambience, subtle background music, 4K HDR, 24fps, clean color grading, lifestyle commercial quality.

title: Gym day: survived, sweated, and somehow left proud 💪😅
text:
Gym day: survived, sweated, and somehow left proud 💪😅

Created with Seedance 2.5 on @wavespeed_ai 

Prompt:

Create a 30-second casual gym vlog featuring the same young woman in her early twenties. She has natural everyday beauty, and her face and hair remain identical throughout the entire video.

Camera & visual style

One continuous handheld front-facing smartphone selfie vlog, always filmed from her own point of view with the phone held in her own hand at arm’s length. No third-person camera, external camera, tripod, cinematic camera movement, or professional filming.

Make it look like a real modern smartphone recording:

- Mild handheld shake and natural walking bounce
- Occasional autofocus hunting
- Small exposure shifts and minor framing imperfections
- Natural front-camera lens distortion
- Soft warm natural daylight transitioning toward early evening
- Natural, uncorrected smartphone color
- No color grading, beauty filter, or skin smoothing
- Same woman, same face and hair throughout
- She holds the phone herself in every shot
- No subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, or on-screen text
- No brand or character names
- Never show a reference sheet or duplicate subject

Outfit

She is wearing a cute, trendy, realistic gym outfit appropriate for a casual workout vlog: fitted athletic top, comfortable high-waisted leggings or shorts, clean sneakers, and minimal accessories. The styling should feel fashionable but natural and practical for the gym.

Scene

She is spending a casual day at the gym and filming herself throughout her workout.

She enters the gym while holding her phone at arm’s length, smiling into the front camera. She briefly sweeps the phone toward the workout area, showing treadmills, weights, machines, and other gym-goers in the background, then brings it back to her face. She grins and says upbeat:

“Okay, gym day! Let’s get this workout started!”

title: What if gravity changed every 3 seconds?
text:
What if gravity changed every 3 seconds? 

Created On Seedance 2.5 Using @weryai .

Prompt 👇 
CHARACTER & VEHICLE CONSISTENCY

Main character: a young Korean woman in her mid-20s, short black hair, wearing a fitted matte-black futuristic riding suit with subtle silver panels and a dark visor helmet. She rides the same sleek black futuristic electric motorcycle throughout the entire video: narrow aerodynamic body, exposed rear suspension, thin glowing cyan wheel rims, single red rear light, no logos.

Environment: the same futuristic megacity at night, tall glass skyscrapers, elevated highways, dense neon advertisements, wet reflective streets, light rain and mist. Keep the architecture, weather and color palette consistent in every shot.

0–3 SEC — THE FIRST REVERSAL

The Korean rider races her black motorcycle through a wet downtown avenue between glowing skyscrapers. Traffic moves normally around her. Suddenly, every vehicle ahead of her begins to lift off the asphalt at the exact same moment as gravity reverses. Cars, buses and motorcycles rise silently toward the sky while loose rain droplets float upward.

Camera: low rear tracking shot directly behind her motorcycle, following at wheel height; slowly push closer as the vehicles begin rising.
Lighting: cyan and magenta neon reflections on the wet road, headlights cutting through mist, soft red taillights floating upward.
Action: the rider looks upward without stopping, then immediately accelerates.

3–6 SEC — THE CITY TURNS UPSIDE DOWN

Gravity completely reverses. The cars that were rising now accelerate toward the undersides of skyscrapers and elevated roads, while the rider's motorcycle is pulled upward as well. She leans forward and activates the bike's magnetic tires, locking herself temporarily to the road.

Camera: transition from rear tracking to a wide side shot revealing the scale of the city, then rotate the camera 90 degrees as the world visually turns sideways.
Lighting: neon signs streak across the frame, cyan energy illuminates the motorcycle wheels, red brake lights of floating cars create moving trails.
Action: a falling car narrowly misses her and crashes onto the side of a skyscraper.

6–9 SEC — SECOND REVERSAL

Without warning, gravity switches back. Every floating vehicle suddenly drops toward the original street. The rider releases the magnetic tires and launches forward just before a massive futuristic bus crashes onto the road behind her.

Camera: fast front-facing tracking shot moving backward in front of the motorcycle, keeping her centered while vehicles fall behind her; quick camera shake at the impact.
Lighting: bright headlights, showers of sparks, rain illuminated by neon signs, thick smoke from the crashing vehicles.
Action: she performs a precise high-speed drift between two falling cars.

9–12 SEC — THIRD REVERSAL

Gravity reverses again. The entire street—including the motorcycle, the rider and hundreds of vehicles—is violently pulled upward. The rider races along the vertical glass surface of a skyscraper as if it were a highway, while cars fly past her in both directions.

Camera: dramatic aerial chase shot that reveals the city rotating beneath her, then rapidly drops alongside the motorcycle for a close side profile.
Lighting: cyan skyscraper lights reflect across the wet black bike, with deep violet atmospheric light between the buildings.
Action: she narrowly avoids a spinning sports car and continues accelerating upward.

12–15 SEC — THE IMPOSSIBLE ESCAPE

The gravity field collapses for one final moment. The entire city appears suspended in mid-air—cars, rain, debris and the rider's motorcycle frozen together above the streets. The rider spots a perfectly aligned gap between three floating vehicles and accelerates through it just as gravity suddenly returns.

title: Journey through Hell made with seedance 2.5
text:
Journey through Hell made with seedance 2.5

prompt :One continuous 30-second chaotic amateur first-person smartphone video filmed by a standing passenger inside a completely packed magnetic-levitation commuter train. Single unbroken take with no cuts, jump cuts, dissolves, crossfades, double exposures, portals, morphing or artificial scene transitions. The train begins as an ordinary weekday commute on Earth and then physically travels downward on an impossible journey — through subway tunnels into bedrock, into a colossal void beneath the crust, past a soot-blackened waiting platform, through an immense eroded gate, out above a burning plain, down the terraced wall of a vast pit, and into the inhabited depths of Hell. Everything must feel physically connected, as though the same train is genuinely travelling down through each environment.
The tone is bureaucratic dread, not horror-movie shock. This is a scheduled service. The route is old, the infrastructure is worn, and the train runs it the way it runs any other line. The horror comes from how ordinary the journey is and how enormous the destination turns out to be.
The interior is a completely packed standing-room-only maglev commuter car. Passengers are pressed shoulder-to-shoulder, gripping overhead straps and vertical poles. Backpacks are squeezed between bodies, coats and loose clothing shift with acceleration, straps swing on their inertia, and the entire carriage constantly vibrates and rattles. The camera is a cheap smartphone held at chest height by one standing passenger who grips a pole with the other hand. The phone itself is NEVER visible because the phone is the camera. The framing is crooked, slightly off-centre, partially blocked by shoulders and arms, and imperfect like genuine accidental footage. The camera constantly shakes, rolls, yaws and gets thrown around by acceleration. Use realistic rolling-shutter distortion, autofocus hunting, exposure pumping, blown highlights, crushed noisy shadows, low-bitrate compression, macroblocking and smeared motion blur. It must look like genuine spontaneous smartphone footage, not professional cinematic footage.
The camera always looks through the LEFT-SIDE WINDOWS at approximately 90 degrees to the train's direction of travel. The train always travels forward and the outside world always streams past the windows from front-to-back. Never switch to a forward-facing train-nose view. Never show the front of the train. The same carriage, same passengers, same poles, same straps and same windows remain visually consistent throughout the entire journey. The interior is the constant realistic anchor while the outside world becomes increasingly impossible.
0 to 3 seconds. Begin with an ordinary overcast weekday commute on an elevated urban line. Grey apartment blocks, rooftop water tanks, a scrapyard, overhead wires, a canal and traffic on a road below streak past the left windows at different distances with realistic parallax. The passengers are tired and mostly uninterested — some on phones, some staring out, some talking quietly. A calm public-address chime sounds and an announcer quietly says, "Next stop: Hell." Nobody reacts. One passenger glances up briefly and goes back to their phone. The train accelerates and everyone instinctively tightens their grip as the carriage gives a hard lateral jolt.
3 to 6 seconds. The line drops into a cutting and then into a tunnel. Tiled subway walls, cable runs, service lights and a passing platform strobe across the windows in hard bands of light and dark, throwing the carriage into stuttering illumination. The tunnel ages as the train descends: modern concrete becomes older brickwork, then rough-cut stone. The fittings become scorched and soot-caked — blackened signal lights, corroded brackets, cabling burnt down to bare metal. This route has been running a long time. The gradient steepens noticeably; passengers lean back against the pitch

Use realistic rolling-shutter distortion, autofocus hunting, exposure pumping, blown highlights, crushed noisy shadows, low-bitrate compression, macroblocking and smeared motion blur. It must look like genuine spontaneous smartphone footage, not professional cinematic footage.
The camera always looks through the LEFT-SIDE WINDOWS at approximately 90 degrees to the train's direction of travel. The train always travels forward and the outside world always streams past the windows from front-to-back. Never switch to a forward-facing train-nose view. Never show the front of the train. The same carriage, same passengers, same poles, same straps and same windows remain visually consistent throughout the entire journey. The interior is the constant realistic anchor while the outside world becomes increasingly impossible.
0 to 3 seconds. Begin with an ordinary overcast weekday commute on an elevated urban line. Grey apartment blocks, rooftop water tanks, a scrapyard, overhead wires, a canal and traffic on a road below streak past the left windows at different distances with realistic parallax. The passengers are tired and mostly uninterested — some on phones, some staring out, some talking quietly. A calm public-address chime sounds and an announcer quietly says, "Next stop: Hell." Nobody reacts. One passenger glances up briefly and goes back to their phone. The train accelerates and everyone instinctively tightens their grip as the carriage gives a hard lateral jolt.
3 to 6 seconds. The line drops into a cutting and then into a tunnel. Tiled subway walls, cable runs, service lights and a passing platform strobe across the windows in hard bands of light and dark, throwing the carriage into stuttering illumination. The tunnel ages as the train descends: modern concrete becomes older brickwork, then rough-cut stone. The fittings become scorched and soot-caked — blackened signal lights, corroded brackets, cabling burnt down to bare metal. This route has been running a long time. title: A Quiet Moment Alone! 🤍
text:
A Quiet Moment Alone!  🤍

She Stayed in the Rain, 
Sometimes, silence says everything. 🌧️ 

🎥 Powered by Seedance 2.5 in @imagineart_creo

Prompt 👇

One continuous personal recording, 25 seconds, handheld, ordinary and unperformed.
OPERATOR LOCK: the camera is held by someone standing just inside the apartment
at the open sliding door, filming her casually through the doorway and stepping
half a step out later — it is a person's hands and it SHOWS: it drifts,
re-aims, reacts late, leans, and cuts her off at the frame edge. ANTI-POLISH
LOCK: NO stabilization, gimbal, drone, slow motion, dramatic lighting, cinematic
choreography, rack focus, lens flares, commercial color grading or polished
cinematography. NO music of any kind. The recording ENDS ABRUPTLY mid-motion, no
fade, no composed final frame.

CAPTURE: shot on an early smartphone — soft image detail, mild motion blur,
visible digital noise in the dim interior, imperfect white balance that shifts
as the camera moves from the room toward the doorway, slightly muted color,
natural compression, exposure hunting against the flat bright grey sky outside.
A small third-floor apartment balcony on a quiet residential street: chipped
concrete floor, a low painted railing, an air-conditioner unit, a folding
drying rack with two shirts on it, six or seven potted plants along the wall, a
plastic stool. Overcast afternoon, heavy still air before rain. Grade: flat,
grey-green, unglamorous — the texture of a forgotten personal recording, NOT a
film, NOT a commercial, NOT AI.

SUBJECT: YUKI, a Japanese woman in her late twenties, plain face with no makeup,
black hair twisted up and clipped with strands falling loose at the neck, small
build, wearing an oversized faded grey t-shirt, black cotton shorts, and worn
house slippers, with a thin hair tie around her wrist. Keep her face, identity,
body proportions, hairstyle, clothing, slippers and hair tie completely
consistent from first frame to last.

THE DOORWAY — She slides the door open and steps out with a plastic watering
can. The camera follows late from inside the room and takes a moment to find
focus on her through the glass; her reflection sits over her for a second before
the operator moves.

THE PLANTS — She crouches and waters the pots one by one, moving the can close
to the soil. She pushes a loose strand of hair back with her forearm. She stands
and the operator reacts late, cutting off the top of her head before correcting.

THE EMPTY CAN — The can runs out before the last pot. She tips it further,
shakes it, gets a few drops, and gives up. She sets the can down on the concrete
and leaves it there.

THE RAIN — Rain starts suddenly and hard. She flinches, half-turns toward the
door, then stops and stays. The camera pans late to the railing where the water
is hitting. Her shoulders and forearms go wet, loose strands of hair stick to her
neck, the concrete floor darkens, water runs off the air-conditioner unit.

THE WATCHING — She rests her forearms on the wet railing and looks out at the
street, doing nothing. Her hair stays flat and wet, her t-shirt stays dark
across the shoulders, the floor stays soaked. She glances back toward the camera
once and gives a small tired half-smile that she does not hold. She looks at the
two shirts getting soaked on the drying rack, half-reaches for them, then leaves
them. The camera drifts off her onto the rain hitting the empty railing and
holds there on nothing.

Sound: water pouring into soil, plastic can knocking on concrete, slippers on
wet floor, the door track sliding, rain hitting concrete and the metal
air-conditioner unit, water dripping off the roof edge, distant tyres on a wet
road, one bird, plus the operator's hand on the phone body, clothing rustle and
breath — no music, no narration, no soundtrack, no artificial sound effects.

Global style lock: ultra-realistic amateur personal footage; she NEVER poses,
holds eye contact or performs — she does not tilt her head back into the rain,
spread her arms, spin, close her eyes serenely or smile at the sky, only small
ordinary acknowledgements; no crowds, no landmarks, no advertisements, no
recognizable brands; the watering can, the potted plants, the drying rack, the
two shirts and the plastic stool behave as separate physical objects and stay
where they are set down; no extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs,
distorted anatomy, floating objects or teleportation; feet stay connected to the
ground; once the rain starts, wet hair, wet clothes, wet skin and wet concrete
PERSIST in every following moment and never dry; ends abruptly mid-motion, no
fade; NOT a commercial, NOT a fashion film, NOT a music video, NOT a
professional production — quiet, still, slightly melancholic, human. The
emotional appeal comes from small things: a watering can running empty, getting
rained on and not going inside, laundry left to get wet.

title: CapCutさん、クレジットの値上げも
text:
「ついてこれる？👻💨」

CapCutさん、クレジットの値上げも
なかなかの負担ですが……

1080pで3960クレジットはさすがに高すぎるよ😭

Made with Seedance 2.5 on CapCut
@capcutapp_jp
#CapCutCPP #CapCut生成AI

Seedance 2.5 Prompt:⬇️

【参照画像】を唯一の主人公キャラクター参照として使用する。Seedance 2.5向け、16:9・30秒・60fps。映像全体を一本の連続した超高速シネマティック・ワンカットとして生成する。通常の編集カット、暗転による場面転換、フェード、突然の場所変更は禁止。30秒間すべての変化に「直前の映像から次の映像へ移動する物理的な理由」を持たせる。人物の視線、身体の回転、走行、ジャンプ、手の動き、ゴースト召喚、ゴーストの飛行、カメラオービット、ゴーストの口への突入、空中落下、ウェブ射出、壁面接着、張力、スイング、空中回転を一本の運動軌道として連結する。テンポは非常に速く、0.3〜1.0秒単位で映像的アクセントを発生させるが、複数の無関係なショットを並べた高速編集には絶対にしない。重要なのは「超高速なのに30秒全部が物理的につながっている」こと。開始から終了まで主人公、ゴースト、撮影カメラのいずれかが常に動き続ける。

【最重要コンセプト】 【参照画像】の鮮烈なアニメ少女が、3A級フォトリアル実写の近未来都市へそのまま存在している。主人公だけは実写化しない。【参照画像】本来の2Dアニメ／高級デジタルイラスト質感を30秒間維持し、都市、建築、空、ガラス、金属、道路、光、影、反射、霧、水蒸気、遠景、空気、ウェブライン、環境物理だけを徹底的なフォトリアル実写として描写する。「どう見てもアニメキャラクターなのに、本物の実写都市の光を受け、本物の空間を走り、本物の建物からウェブで飛んでいる」という異質な共存そのものを映像美にする。主人公の輪郭は鮮明に保つが、背景へ貼り付けたステッカーにはしない。実写環境の方向光、床からの反射光、建物からの色被り、遮蔽物による影をアニメ塗りへ反映し、実写床への接地影、ガラスへの色とシルエットの反射、手前の実写物による自然な遮蔽を成立させる。

【主人公固定】 【参照画像】の成人女性キャラクターを完全維持。鮮やかな青髪、前髪、サイドの髪、まとめた髪、赤い大きなリボン、赤白の帽子、白いポンポン、ハート型サングラス、紫〜ピンク系レンズ、小さなイヤリング、白いファー、黒いミニドレス、赤いネイル、指輪を維持。顔、瞳、髪型、髪色、身体比率、衣装、アクセサリーを途中変更しない。シャープで高品質な2Dセルアニメ＋デジタルイラスト質感、鮮明な線画、青・赤・白の色彩、滑らかなセルシェーディングを維持する。ただし平面画像を貼り付けた存在にはせず、横顔、背面、ローアングル、俯瞰、空中回転でも同一人物として360度の身体整合性を保つ。髪、リボン、白いファー、衣装には速度、風圧、加速度に応じた自然な遅れを与える。

【ゴースト固定】 【参照画像】に存在する白いゴーストを召喚存在の基本デザインとして使用。白〜淡い水色の柔らかな半透明ボディ、丸く可愛いシルエット、赤〜ピンク系の目と口、淡いピンクの頬を維持し、怖い悪霊ではなく主人公の遊び相手のような愛嬌のある存在にする。召喚個体は同系統だが完全コピーにはせず、サイズ、表情、尾のカーブ、飛び方に小さな個性を持たせる。大量発生は禁止。序盤で必ず1体ずつ増加し最大5体。主人公の周囲を異なる高さ、距離、速度で立体的に飛ぶ。ゴーストも主人公と同じアニメ世界側の質感を維持するが、半透明部分では背後のフォトリアル都市が自然に透過・屈折して見える。

【舞台｜NEO FUTURE CITY】 夕方からブルーアワーへ入り始める巨大近未来都市。単なるビル屋上は禁止。開始地点は超高層建築群の中層部に浮かぶ巨大な空中公共プラザ。地上数百メートルにあり、複数の高層建築がガラス製スカイブリッジ、磁気交通レール、巨大な構造梁、空中歩廊で接続されている。3A級SF映画そのもののフォトリアル実写質感。巨大ガラスファサード、チタン、濡れた黒石床、コンクリート、半透明パネル、可動ルーバー、控えめな発光交通誘導ライン、遠方を高速移動する無人交通システム。過剰なサイバーパンクネオンにはしない。実在しそうな近未来建築として成立させる。上空には巨大な立体道路と磁気レール、遠方には空中交通機、薄い雲の間から夕方の自然光が差し、ガラス建築へ青と金の反射が走る。後半のウェブスイング用に左右20〜50m間隔で高層建築を配置し、ウェブが接着可能な外壁、梁、アンテナ構造を明確に見せる。

【カメラ基本設計】 3A級アクション映画＋高級スポーツCMの撮影品質。フルサイズデジタルシネマカメラ。高速移動時18〜21mm、人物寄り24〜28mm、ゴースト口への突入時は超広角マクロ的な迫力。60fps。高速運動を読めるシャッター速度を維持し、必要な方向だけ自然なモーションブラーを付与。意味のない360度回転、ランダムロール、AI的な急ズームは禁止。カメラのロール、バンク、オービットには主人公、ゴースト、ウェブ張力など必ず運動中心を設定する。速度を一定にせず、急加速→超接近→オービット→一瞬の速度差→再加速を繰り返し、高速でも単調にならないカメラリズムを作る。

【0.00〜3.50秒｜いきなり走る少女＋最初のゴースト召喚】 第1フレームから強烈な運動。【参照画像】の主人公が巨大な近未来空中プラザを全速力でこちらへ走っている。外部カメラは主人公の正面約1.5m、腰より低いローアングルから高速後退。主人公は楽しそうに笑い、白いファー、赤いリボン、青髪が速度に応じて後方へ激しく揺れる。実写の濡れた床へアニメ主人公の影が高速で流れ、周囲のガラスへ青髪と赤いリボンの色が一瞬反射する。0.70秒付近、主人公が走行を止めず右手を横へ振り抜く。指先から赤・青・白の絵の具を一筆で引いたような2Dペイントストロークが実写空間へ描かれ、円弧を形成した瞬間「ぽんっ！」と1体目のゴーストが筆跡から勢いよく飛び出す。魔法陣ではない。派手だが短い絵描きエフェクト。ゴーストは主人公の肩横へ並んで飛行し、主人公が横目で見ながら「ついてこれる？」と笑う。日本語、完全リップシンク。ゴーストは嬉しそうに上下へ弾むが主人公は一切停止しない。

【3.50〜7.50秒｜走りながら次々召喚】 主人公は空中プラザの構造梁や透明パネルを縫うように高速走行。カメラは正面から左側へ高速オービットし、主人公も走りながら身体を半回転。左手で空中を斜めに切ると青白い筆跡から2体目、「ぽんっ！」。手首を返すと短い赤いペイントスプラッシュから3体目。腕を頭上へ回すと白いリボン状の一筆が空間を切り、その先端から4体目。最後に両手を一度だけ前へ突き出し、青・赤・白の太いブラシストロークが交差した地点から少し大きな5体目が出現。一度に大量生成しない。必ず1体→2体→3体→4体→5体と視覚的に増加し、先に召喚された個体は消えない。5体は頭上、肩横、腰横、前方上空、後方など異なる高さと半径を高速飛行し、主人公を中心とする立体的な螺旋運動を形成。1体が撮影レンズすれすれを高速通過し、半透明ボディ越しに主人公と実写都市が屈折して見えるが、これを編集カットには使わない。

【7.50〜10.20秒｜巨大ゴーストが前へ出る】 主人公は空中プラザの端へ向かってさらに加速。前方は数百メートル下まで落ち込む巨大都市空間だが減速しない。5体のゴーストも速度を上げ、そのうち最大の1体が主人公の横から前へ飛び出し、後ろ向きに飛行しながら直径約3〜4mまで急速に巨大化する。可愛さと基本デザインは維持。巨大ゴーストが主人公を見て「今からいくよ〜！」と明るく可愛い声で叫び、口の開閉を完全同期。セリフ終了と同時に口を大きく開く。口内は単なる黒穴ではなく、赤・青・白・ピンクの2D絵の具が猛烈な速度で渦巻く異空間。主人公は「えっ、そこ！？」と驚きながら笑うが走行を止めない。巨大ゴーストの口から強烈な吸引が発生し、主人公の青髪、赤いリボン、白いファーが前方へ引かれ、小さなゴーストたちも吸引方向へ流される。撮影カメラは主人公の背後へ回り込み、主人公と一緒に巨大ゴーストの口へ物理的に引き込まれる。

【0.00〜3.50秒｜いきなり走る少女＋最初のゴースト召喚】 第1フレームから強烈な運動。【参照画像】の主人公が巨大な近未来空中プラザを全速力でこちらへ走っている。外部カメラは主人公の正面約1.5m、腰より低いローアングルから高速後退。主人公は楽しそうに笑い、白いファー、赤いリボン、青髪が速度に応じて後方へ激しく揺れる。実写の濡れた床へアニメ主人公の影が高速で流れ、周囲のガラスへ青髪と赤いリボンの色が一瞬反射する。0.70秒付近、主人公が走行を止めず右手を横へ振り抜く。指先から赤・青・白の絵の具を一筆で引いたような2Dペイントストロークが実写空間へ描かれ、円弧を形成した瞬間「ぽんっ！」と1体目のゴーストが筆跡から勢いよく飛び出す。魔法陣ではない。派手だが短い絵描きエフェクト。ゴーストは主人公の肩横へ並んで飛行し、主人公が横目で見ながら「ついてこれる？」と笑う。日本語、完全リップシンク。ゴーストは嬉しそうに上下へ弾むが主人公は一切停止しない。

【3.50〜7.50秒｜走りながら次々召喚】 主人公は空中プラザの構造梁や透明パネルを縫うように高速走行。カメラは正面から左側へ高速オービットし、主人公も走りながら身体を半回転。左手で空中を斜めに切ると青白い筆跡から2体目、「ぽんっ！」。手首を返すと短い赤いペイントスプラッシュから3体目。腕を頭上へ回すと白いリボン状の一筆が空間を切り、その先端から4体目。最後に両手を一度だけ前へ突き出し、青・赤・白の太いブラシストロークが交差した地点から少し大きな5体目が出現。一度に大量生成しない。必ず1体→2体→3体→4体→5体と視覚的に増加し、先に召喚された個体は消えない。5体は頭上、肩横、腰横、前方上空、後方など異なる高さと半径を高速飛行し、主人公を中心とする立体的な螺旋運動を形成。1体が撮影レンズすれすれを高速通過し、半透明ボディ越しに主人公と実写都市が屈折して見えるが、これを編集カットには使わない。

【7.50〜10.20秒｜巨大ゴーストが前へ出る】 主人公は空中プラザの端へ向かってさらに加速。前方は数百メートル下まで落ち込む巨大都市空間だが減速しない。5体のゴーストも速度を上げ、そのうち最大の1体が主人公の横から前へ飛び出し、後ろ向きに飛行しながら直径約3〜4mまで急速に巨大化する。可愛さと基本デザインは維持。巨大ゴーストが主人公を見て「今からいくよ〜！」と明るく可愛い声で叫び、口の開閉を完全同期。セリフ終了と同時に口を大きく開く。口内は単なる黒穴ではなく、赤・青・白・ピンクの2D絵の具が猛烈な速度で渦巻く異空間。主人公は「えっ、そこ！？」と驚きながら笑うが走行を止めない。巨大ゴーストの口から強烈な吸引が発生し、主人公の青髪、赤いリボン、白いファーが前方へ引かれ、小さなゴーストたちも吸引方向へ流される。撮影カメラは主人公の背後へ回り込み、主人公と一緒に巨大ゴーストの口へ物理的に引き込まれる。

【10.20〜12.20秒｜一度だけの巨大PAINT IMPACT】 主人公がプラザ端を蹴ってジャンプし、その勢いと吸引によって巨大ゴーストの口へ突入。口の縁を通過する瞬間だけ、30秒中最大となる一発の派手なエフェクトを発生させる。赤、青、白、ピンクの巨大2Dペイントストローク、液体インク、セルアニメ速度線、荒いブラシ飛沫がフォトリアル実写画面全体を猛烈な速度で一周し、巨大な絵筆で映画フィルムそのものを一瞬塗り替えたようなPAINT IMPACTを形成。爆発、魔法陣、レーザー、粒子爆発にはしない。カメラは止まらず絵の具層を物理的に突破。口内部を長いトンネルにはせず1秒以内で通過し、ペイント層の奥に同じ近未来都市の遥か上空が現れる。絵の具が高速で左右へ裂け、その裂け目から主人公と撮影カメラが都市上空へ一気に射出される。ここだけが大規模なエフェクト変化であり、以後同規模のトランジションを繰り返さない。

【12.20〜14.50秒｜都市上空へ射出】 主人公がフォトリアル近未来都市の数百メートル上空へ高速で放り出される。遥か下には立体道路、巨大ガラスビル、磁気交通レール、移動車両。主人公は自由飛行せず、射出時の上向き慣性が失われた後に明確な重力落下へ入る。カメラは主人公の横から急降下して身体の下へ潜り、都市を背景にローアングルで見上げる。主人公の周囲から先ほどの5体のゴーストが次々に飛び出して再合流。ゴーストだけは自由に空中飛行可能。1体が主人公のすぐ横へ並び、主人公は落下しながら「うわ、たっか！」と笑って叫ぶ。ゴーストも楽しそうに口を開けて笑う。主人公はすぐに表情を切り替え、右前方の高層建築へ視線を固定する。

【14.50〜18.00秒｜1本目ウェブ射出→接着→張力→高速スイング】 前方右側に巨大なガラス＋金属外壁の高層建築。主人公が落下しながら右腕を肩から大きく前へ振り、手首を鋭くスナップ。手首／手の位置から細く強靭な白〜淡青色のウェブラインを1本だけ明確に射出する。ウェブは実写空間内に存在する半透明の高強度繊維として描写。途中から突然出現させず、手元から先端が高速で伸び、空中を横切り、右前方ビルの外壁へ到達する全過程を見せる。「パチッ！」と接着し、接着点でごく小さな実写粉塵。その直後にラインがピンと張る。まず右腕が張力方向へ引かれ、続いて肩、胸、腰、脚へ力が伝達。下向きだった落下速度が前方向の速度へ変換され、身体全体がウェブ接着点を中心とした巨大な振り子軌道へ入る。カメラも右へ強くバンクしながら追従。主人公の横を5体のゴーストが猛スピードで追走し、1体は前方、2体は左右、残りは後方。ゴースト自身はウェブを使用しない。

【18.00〜21.00秒｜ビルすれすれの超高速スイング＋会話】 主人公がスイング最下点へ到達し速度最大。実写ビル壁まで1〜2mの超接近。ガラス面へアニメ主人公とゴーストの反射が猛烈な速度で走る。主人公は身体を横へ倒し、脚を曲げて建築物の突起を紙一重で回避。カメラは後方斜め下から壁面との狭い隙間へ入り込み、21mm広角で速度と距離感を強調。ゴースト1体が主人公のすぐ横へ追いつき「もっと速くする？」。主人公は前方を見たまま楽しそうに「もちろん！」。完全リップシンク。会話中も高速スイング、髪、リボン、ファー、背景の流れを絶対に止めない。カメラが横から主人公の顔へ急接近した直後、主人公が右手を開いて1本目のウェブをリリース。張力が消え、蓄積した慣性によって身体が斜め上へ高速射出される。

【21.00〜24.00秒｜2本目ウェブ＋さらに速度上昇】 主人公は空中へ放り出された勢いを維持したまま素早く身体を半回転。カメラも主人公を中心に約120度だけ意味のあるオービットを行い、正面斜め上から顔を捉える。左前方に別の高層建築が現れ、主人公が左腕を伸ばして2本目のウェブラインを射出。先端が空中を走る過程を明確に見せ、左側ビル上部外壁へ実際に接着。「パチッ！」。ラインが張り、左腕が引かれ、肩、胴体、腰、脚へ張力が伝達して進行方向が急激に左へ変化。主人公は巨大な弧を描き、近未来都市の空中交通レール下を高速通過。カメラも張力方向へ左ロールし、地平線が物理的理由を持って大きく傾く。ゴーストたちは主人公の周囲を高速で交差しながら追走。大きめのゴーストが横へ並んで「まだいける〜？」。主人公は風の中で可愛く笑いながら「もっとスピード出していくよ〜！」と叫ぶ。後半の主要セリフとして明瞭に聞かせる。喋っている間も左手のウェブを保持し、身体は最高速度のスイングを続ける。

【24.00〜27.00秒｜ウェブ解放→都市上空へ大ジャンプ】 主人公が2本目のスイング上昇側へ入り、ビル屋上付近まで一気に上昇。最も速度を高さへ変換できる瞬間に左手を開いてウェブをリリースし、蓄積した運動エネルギーで屋上よりさらに高い空中へ射出される。5体のゴーストも一斉に上昇。主人公は上昇中に片脚を大きく前へ伸ばし、身体を横へ捻って約180度回転、両腕を広げる。青髪、赤いリボン、白いファーが強風を受け大きく遅れて追従。カメラは主人公の真下から猛烈に上昇して主人公を追い越し、そのまま前方へ回り込んで後退しながら正対。背後には数百メートル下へ広がる巨大なフォトリアル近未来都市。主人公の上昇速度が減少し、自然に自由落下へ移行。ゴースト5体も速度を調整しながら主人公の周囲へ集合し始める。

【27.00〜30.00秒｜空中の可愛い決めポーズ＋絵描きエフェクト】 最後はシャッター、カメラ、レンズ、絞りを一切使用しない。主人公は都市上空を落下しながら身体をカメラ正面へ向け、5体のゴーストが左右、頭上、足元、後方へ立体配置。主人公は悪戯っぽく笑い、右手を顔の横へ持ち上げて小さなVサイン、左脚を軽く曲げ、身体を斜めにした【参照画像】らしい可愛く自信のある空中ポーズへ入る。ただし完全静止せず落下、髪、リボン、衣装、ゴーストの浮遊運動は継続。肩横のゴースト1体も身体を曲げて主人公を真似したポーズ。別のゴーストはカメラへ笑う。主人公がVサインをほどき、右手の人差し指で空中を大きく一筆描く。その指先から鮮烈な青→赤→白→ピンクの2Dペイントラインが発生し、主人公の腕の軌跡へ完全同期して巨大な弧を描く。ラインは主人公とゴーストたちの前後を立体的に一周し、一筆書きのハート＋星を思わせる抽象的な絵描きシルエットを形成するが、文字やロゴにはしない。5体のゴーストは消滅させず、ペイントラインへそれぞれ小さな色の尾を描きながら主人公の周囲へ高速集合。カメラは主人公へ急接近し、主人公が最後にウインク。実写近未来都市、鮮烈な2Dアニメ少女、白いゴースト、空中を走る巨大な絵筆ストロークが同一画面で最大密度になる。29.70秒、主人公がVサインをカメラ方向へ少し突き出し、ゴーストたちも周囲で一斉に可愛い決めポーズ。ペイントラインが外周を高速で一周してフレームを装飾。29.90秒、巨大な赤・青・白・ピンクの一筆がレンズすれすれを横切るが暗転させない。30.00秒、フォトリアル近未来都市の遥か上空で【参照画像】のアニメ少女と5体のゴーストが、巨大な手描きエフェクトの中央で可愛い決めポーズを取る鮮烈な一瞬を最終フレームとして終了。フェードアウト禁止。

【音響・音楽】 冒頭からテンポの速いbright electro-pop × futuristic breakbeat。重すぎるEDMは禁止。主人公の可愛さと高速アクションを両立するtight kick、clean bass、crisp percussion、short digital synth、playful pluck、細かなglitch accent。召喚時は毎回短い「ぽんっ」「シュッ」を動作へ同期し、召喚数が増えるほど音楽レイヤーも少しずつ増加。ゴーストの声は可愛く軽く、少し空気感のある声だが過剰なエコーは禁止。主人公は若い成人女性の明るく自由奔放で少し小悪魔的な声。幼児声にはしない。セリフは指定箇所のみ。「ついてこれる？」「今からいくよ〜！」「えっ、そこ！？」「うわ、たっか！」「もっと速くする？」「もちろん！」「まだいける〜？」「もっとスピード出していくよ〜！」。同じセリフを繰り返さない。別タイミングで勝手に喋らない。主人公とゴーストを取り違えない。すべて完全リップシンク。ゴースト口への吸引では低い吸引音＋高速ペイントスウッシュ。10秒付近の巨大PAINT IMPACTだけ音楽にも強烈な一発アクセント。都市上空へ射出された瞬間に風圧を大きく開放。ウェブ射出「シュパッ」、壁面接着「パチッ」、張力発生時に短い低音、スイング速度に応じて風切り音のピッチを上昇。最後の絵描きエフェクトにはdry brush swipeを主人公の指の動きへ同期させる。

【絶対優先事項】 【参照画像】の主人公を最初から最後まで同一人物として維持。主人公は30秒間アニメキャラクターのままで、フォトリアル化、2.5D化、3D化しない。背景は徹底した3A級フォトリアル実写近未来都市。主人公と実写背景の異質な質感差を意図的に残す。ただし光、影、反射、接地、遮蔽、風、速度は同一空間として物理的に成立させる。カメラ小道具は登場させない。自撮りを行わない。写真を生成しない。序盤は主人公自身の手の動きによってゴーストを1体ずつ召喚し、既存個体を消さず最大5体まで増加。召喚は短い2Dペイント表現。大規模なエフェクト変化は巨大ゴーストの口へ突入する一度だけ。巨大ゴーストが「今からいくよ〜！」と言った直後に口を開き、主人公と撮影視点がその口へ物理的に吸い込まれる。口内から同じ近未来都市上空へ連続して射出。主人公は自由飛行せず重力で落下。ウェブラインは必ず主人公の手首／手から射出し、先端が建物へ飛ぶ過程、接着、ラインが張る瞬間、張力が腕から全身へ伝達して落下軌道がスイングへ変換される過程を見せる。最低2回「射出→接着→張力→スイング」を成立させる。ゴーストは主人公の隣を自力飛行し後半まで存在。高速移動中にも主人公とゴーストの自然な会話を成立させる。最後は空中で主人公＋5体のゴーストによる可愛い決めポーズと、主人公自身が指先で描く巨大2Dペイントラインを同期させる。

【禁止】 主人公の実写化、2.5D化、3Dアニメ化、ゲームCG化、プラスチック3D化、顔変更、髪色変更、髪型変更、衣装変更、アクセサリー消失、赤いリボン消失、サングラス消失、白ファー消失、主人公複製、別人化、年齢変化、追加人間キャラクター、ゴーストの恐怖化、ゾンビ化、悪霊化、血液、ゴア、主人公とゴーストの融合、余分な腕、余分な脚、余分な手、6本指、指融合、身体ねじれ、関節破綻、ランダムテレポート、通常編集カット、途中暗転、フェード、理由のないワープ、カメラ小道具、自撮り、写真生成、レンズ内部、絞り羽根、シャッター演出、魔法陣、巨大レーザー、爆発、意味のない火花、過剰粒子、過剰Bloom、白飛び、主人公輪郭の消失、背景までアニメ化、都市全体のゲームCG化、意味のない360度回転、停止ポーズ、スローモーション、低速歩行だけの時間、ウェブなしの主人公の自由飛行、ウェブが空中で終わる、ウェブが胸や胴体から出る、接着を見せずにスイング開始、建物貫通、ゴースト一括大量生成、召喚済みゴーストの突然消失、同一セリフの重複、勝手な追加セリフ、話者入れ替わり、字幕、文字、ロゴ、UI、最後の黒フェードを禁止する。

title: Made with seedance 2.5
text:
Made with seedance 2.5

Prompt: Main Subject: young korean woman <<<image_1>>>, naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely tied back. Wearing an oversized faded blue sweatshirt, loose beige pants, white sneakers, and a thin silver necklace. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.

Location: Quiet Seoul neighborhood just before sunrise. Narrow residential streets, old apartment buildings, utility poles, parked cars, tangled overhead wires, small shops with shutters still closed, and an elevated railway visible beyond the rooftops. Cool early-morning haze slowly turning warm as the sun rises.

Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video. Candid, quiet and completely unstaged. Handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, DV compression, slight motion blur and low-level microphone noise. No stabilization or modern cinematic movement.

00:00–00:03: She walks quietly through the nearly empty neighborhood, hands tucked into her sweatshirt pockets. The camera follows several steps behind, occasionally drifting toward the empty street.

00:03–00:06: She reaches a small pedestrian overlook near the elevated railway and leans against the railing. She looks tired but peaceful, watching the tracks below.

00:06–00:09: The distant sound of a train grows louder. She turns toward the tracks and waits. The camera struggles to focus in the dim morning light.

00:09–00:12: The first train suddenly rushes past. The camera shakes from the operator's reaction, briefly losing her behind the moving train. Morning light reflects across the windows.

title: Seedance 2.5 测试一下古装小短剧📺
text:
Seedance 2.5 测试一下古装小短剧📺

prompt 👇

【风格】武侠电影级动作喜剧（Wuxia Action Comedy），古风客栈实景，8K，达芬奇高级调色，升格慢动作与快剪结合，真实布料与木屑物理，横屏16:9
【时长】30秒
【场景】古风江湖客栈大堂，木桌长凳、红灯笼、蒸笼冒热气，梁柱交错，光从窗棂斜射带浮尘
【角色】女侠A @图1（红衣冷艳，用剑）、女侠B @图2（青衣飒爽，用双筷/软鞭），两人武艺相当

[00:00-00:02] 钩子·同时出手
蒸笼掀开——热气散去，只剩孤零零一个白胖包子。两只手"唰"地同时探向它，在包子上方一寸僵住。镜头拉近两人对视，杀气骤起。
音效：蒸汽"嘶"声，一声兵刃出鞘。

[00:02-00:06] 拔剑·桌面开打
A拔剑挑翻整张桌子腾空，B踩着飞起的长凳跃上房梁，包子被气浪震到空中。碗筷茶壶四散飞溅。

[00:06-00:11] 空中争夺（升格）
包子在半空划弧，两人凌空交手，A剑尖挑、B筷子夹，包子在刀光间被抢来抢去，谁也没碰实，热气还在包子上冒。

[00:11-00:16] 客栈大乱
战场蔓延，两人踩桌翻梁、灯笼被削落、木屑纷飞，其他"食客"抱头躲桌下。包子始终在两人争夺中心悬着不落。

[00:16-00:21] 决胜一击（升格特写）
A与B同时使出绝招，剑气与鞭影在包子两侧交汇——包子被劲气托着高高弹起，两人各自摆出接杀造型，屏息等它落下。

[00:21-00:26] 神反转
镜头跟着下落的包子——一只慵懒的橘猫"喵"地从桌上跃起，在半空一口叼住包子，稳稳落地，当着两人的面吧唧吧唧吃完，舔爪。
音效：所有打斗音效戛然而止，一声"喵~"，乌鸦飞过。

[00:26-00:30] 傻眼收尾（定格）
A和B保持着帅气的接杀姿势僵在原地，剑和筷子还举着，齐刷刷看向吃饱打嗝的猫，表情裂开。
字幕（砸出）：「有些仗，打赢了也没用。」
音效：一记喜剧"咚"，猫满足地打了个嗝。

【导演备注】1.反差铁律：打斗越是天崩地裂、招式越华丽正经，最后被猫截胡的落差越好笑；2.身份锁定：A=@图1红衣用剑、B=@图2青衣用筷/鞭，脸/服装全程一致；3.节奏：2秒对峙→拔剑→空中争夺→大乱→决胜→猫反转，动作段用快剪+关键处升格；4.物理真实：包子热气、木屑、灯笼、布料惯性、猫的重量都要真实，武侠不卡通；5.包子必须全程在画面中心被争夺，是视觉焦点和笑点核心；6.不见血、不伤人，纯招式对拆。
【负面提示词】卡通武侠，塑料CG，换脸，两人身份/武器混淆，包子中途消失，猫出现得太早，血腥伤人，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面糊乱，未成年人形象。

title: Golden-hour slice-of-life alley scene, visual only
text:
Seedance 2.0 on Vidfield AI

Prompt:
"Create a 15-second realistic cinematic slice-of-life video in 16:9, 24fps. Visual-only video, no dialogue, no voice, no music, no sound effects, no subtitles, no text on screen. Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft handheld camera, muted film color grade, slight grain, natural shadows, peaceful nostalgic neighborhood mood. Fully realistic live-action style, not game-like, not animated.

Main character: a young Korean woman in her early 20s with messy dark brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, soft natural face, calm gentle expression, dark gray cropped sleeveless tank top, loose light-wash blue jeans, black necklace, casual sneakers. Keep her look consistent in every shot.

Location: a long narrow real-life residential alley between tall tan stone and concrete walls. Sandy dusty ground, warm sunlight glowing on one side, soft tree shadows across the path, palm trees and green leaves visible above the walls, a blue painted wall far ahead, one bicycle leaning near the end of the alley, quiet empty neighborhood feeling.

0:00–0:02:
Rear tracking shot. The Korean woman walks slowly through the long narrow alley from behind. Golden sunlight stretches across the tan walls. Camera follows with natural handheld motion.

0:02–0:04:
Wide alley shot. A small gray-brown tabby cat appears from a low gap near the left side wall and steps into the alley. The woman notices it, slows down, and turns slightly toward it.

0:04–0:06:
Medium side shot. The cat walks near her feet and looks up. She smiles softly, bends down slowly, and extends one hand in a gentle careful way.

0:06–0:08:
Low close-up. The cat sniffs her fingers, then rubs its head against her hand. She gently pets the cat’s head and back. Show realistic fur texture, tiny whisker movement, and natural cat behavior.

0:08–0:10:
Emotional close-up. The woman smiles warmly while petting the cat. Sunlight flickers through tree leaves across her face, shoulders, and hair. Keep the moment soft, calm, and human.

0:10–0:12:
Medium-wide shot. The cat walks ahead a few steps, then looks back at her. She stands slowly and follows it with a curious peaceful smile.

0:12–0:14:
Front tracking shot. She walks toward camera with the cat beside her near the wall. She looks down at the cat and smiles. The long alley, tan walls, blue wall far behind, trees, and bicycle remain visible.

0:14–0:15:
Final close shot. The cat brushes against her leg. She looks toward the camera with a soft peaceful smile, then looks down at the cat again. Hold the warm golden alley atmosphere for a gentle cinematic ending."

title: A WHOLE LIFE CYCLE IN 15 sec!
text:
A WHOLE LIFE CYCLE IN 15 sec!

Made with Seedance 2.0 on @nemovideoai 

Prompt:

Jar = a clear glass jar filled with rich dark soil, sitting on a wooden windowsill in soft natural daylight, a clean simple background, gentle warm light. Environment only. 

SCENE: a beautiful cinematic time-lapse of a single seed germinating and growing inside the glass jar. title: DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally…
text:
Seedance 2.5 

Prompt 
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on a rack, bench, or machine console. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.
STYLE:
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — genuine effort, breathless commentary, real laughs. Quick handheld cuts, energy building progressively from determined to visibly exhausted, camera slightly wobbling by the later cuts to match her shaky legs.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol @tQfebZIFn0ED5GRHDkVe , 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin building up a sweat sheen as the session progresses, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers/leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.
Setting
A gym in the evening — squat rack, leg press machine, leg curl machine, lunge space near the mirror wall, water fountain across the room, soft overhead lighting.

(~2.5s, propped camera at squat rack, medium shot) She stands, hands on hips, psyching herself up. CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, propped camera, squat rack) She performs a few squats, controlled breathing, racks the bar with an exhale. CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."

(~2.5s, medium propped shot, lunges) She performs a few walking lunges, wobbling slightly on the last one, laughing at herself. CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, propped camera, leg press machine) She settles into the leg press, pushes through a rep, face straining. CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) Close-up on her hands gripping the leg press handles, sweat catching the light. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.
(~2.5s, handheld, unsteady walk) She stands up, legs visibly shaking, grabbing the rack for balance, bursting into laughter. CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish) She leans against the wall near the water fountain, catching her breath, tired grin, thumbs up. CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

title: From frozen fries and seasoned chicken to a perfectly golden, crispy meal in just one air fryer
text:
From frozen fries and seasoned chicken to a perfectly golden, crispy meal in just one air fryer. 

A cinematic cooking journey that turns simple ingredients into a delicious, premium-looking feast.

Made With Seedance 2.0

Prompt: Create a 14-second cinematic, ultra-realistic commercial video using the provided air-fryer reference image and storyboard as visual reference.
Keep the same modern black air fryer, same girl, same modern kitchen, same lighting, same overall visual style and composition throughout the entire video. The girl should look consistent in every shot, with the same face, hairstyle, outfit, and appearance.

0–2 seconds:
The girl opens the air fryer drawer and places a generous portion of frozen potato French fries inside. Show a clear close-up of the fries going into the basket.

2–4 seconds:
She places several seasoned chicken leg pieces/drumsticks beside the fries in the same air-fryer basket, keeping both foods separated and clearly visible. Show a detailed top-down/close-up shot of the fries and chicken together.

4–5 seconds:
She closes the air fryer and sets the digital temperature and cooking time on the front touchscreen. Show her finger pressing the controls.

5–8 seconds:
Show the air fryer actively cooking. Use a cinematic close-up through the cooking window/interior: the French fries and chicken legs are cooking simultaneously, gradually becoming golden and crispy. Show realistic heat, gentle steam, and natural cooking movement. The fries become golden and crisp while the chicken develops a delicious roasted surface.

8–10 seconds:
The girl opens the air fryer and checks the perfectly cooked food. Capture the golden fries and juicy, crispy chicken legs in a beautiful close-up.

10–12 seconds:
She uses tongs to transfer the crispy fries and chicken leg pieces onto a clean serving plate. Arrange the fries on one side and the chicken pieces on the other. Make the food look fresh, hot, golden, crispy, and appetizing.

12–14 seconds:
Show a hero close-up of the finished plate beside the air fryer. The camera slowly moves closer to highlight the crispy fries and beautifully cooked chicken.

14–15 seconds:
The girl smiles happily while holding/looking at the finished meal. End with a premium product shot of the air fryer and plated food, with a clean commercial feeling.

Visual style:
Ultra-realistic food commercial, cinematic product advertising, warm modern kitchen lighting, realistic food textures, natural hand movements, realistic steam and heat, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movements, crisp details, premium commercial photography, 4K quality.

Important: Keep the air fryer design consistent with the reference. Do not change the girl’s identity or appearance. Do not add extra people. Keep the fries and chicken cooking together in the same cooking session, and clearly show the complete process from loading → cooking → opening → plating → final delicious result. Avoid distorted hands, extra fingers, warped food, changing kitchen layout, or inconsistent product design.

title: A slow morning, a fresh face, a little self-care, and that feeling of being ready to take…
text:
A slow morning, a fresh face, a little self-care, and that feeling of being ready to take on the whole day. 

Created with seedance 2.5 on @Flovaai 

Prompt:

Create a highly realistic 60-second vertical lifestyle vlog featuring one consistent female creator throughout the entire video. Keep her facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and overall appearance consistent from beginning to end. The footage should feel like a professionally filmed but natural smartphone influencer vlog.

Opening — Slow Morning (0–8 sec)
Start with the woman waking up in a modern, cozy bedroom. Soft morning sunlight comes through the curtains. She sits up slowly, stretches, checks her phone for a moment, and smiles naturally. Use intimate close-ups mixed with smooth handheld shots.

Getting Ready — Fresh Look (8–18 sec)
She heads to the bathroom and prepares for the day. Show her washing her face, brushing her hair, and looking at herself in the mirror. Keep the movements natural and casual, with realistic reflections and soft daylight.

Workout Preparation (18–27 sec)
Back in her room, she puts on a stylish brown athletic outfit and prepares her gym essentials. She grabs her gym bag, puts on her shoes, checks her appearance in the mirror, and confidently heads toward the door.

City Walk (27–37 sec)
She leaves the house and walks through a modern urban neighborhood. Show natural pedestrians, passing vehicles, buildings, and sunlight in the background. Alternate between a cinematic tracking shot from behind and a front-facing vlog shot where she looks toward the camera.

Fitness Session (37–53 sec)
Inside a bright modern fitness center, she begins her workout. Show quick cinematic moments of cardio, stretching, lifting light weights, and taking a short break. Capture realistic sweat, natural breathing, believable body movement, and energetic expressions. Use different camera angles and smooth transitions to keep the sequence engaging.

Ending — Relaxed Creator Moment (53–60 sec)
After finishing her workout, she returns home and relaxes on her bed. She faces the camera, smiles, and casually talks to the audience while making natural hand gestures. End with a confident smile and a subtle camera movement away from her.

Visual Direction: photorealistic human appearance, consistent character identity, natural skin texture, realistic hair and clothing physics, cinematic depth of field, warm natural lighting, subtle handheld smartphone movement, smooth cuts, authentic influencer-vlog aesthetic, realistic environments, high-detail 4K footage.

Avoid identity changes, face distortion, flickering, unnatural expressions, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated objects, unrealistic body proportions, robotic movement, sudden outfit changes, or inconsistent backgrounds.

title: Seedance 2.5 on @itsPolloAI
text:
Seedance 2.5 on @itsPolloAI 

Prompt: Cinematic 28-second video, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, filmic color grade with heavy teal-cyan mist, deep greens, cool desaturated tones, soft volumetric fog, high dynamic range, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens flares, shallow depth of field, 24fps cinematic motion, elegant slow pacing mixed with purposeful energy. Style reference: high-end automotive commercial meets contemplative art-house short (modern Mercedes performance ads). Moody, atmospheric, intimate, powerful.

Character: Young man in his mid-20s, sharp features, well groomed beard and dark messy haur, wearing a dark heavy jacket (almost black denim or soft leather), dark wide-leg pants, black boots. Calm, focused, slightly melancholic expression. Natural movement, realistic weight and fabric physics.

Vehicle: Brand-new silver Mercedes-AMG GT coupe (current generation), metallic silver paint with perfect reflections, illuminated red taillights, quad exhaust tips, large AMG multi-spoke wheels, detailed panamericana grille, modern digital cockpit with large central touchscreen and digital instrument cluster. License plate visible. Wet asphalt reflections.

Environment: Remote high-altitude mountain road in dense, thick fog. Rolling green hills covered in short wet grass and moss, rocky outcrops, distant soft mountain silhouettes disappearing into the mist. Overcast, diffused natural light with no direct sun. Cool, humid atmosphere. Occasional black sheep silhouette in the fog.

Shot-by-shot timeline (precise 28-second structure):

0.0–2.5s: Wide establishing shot from behind and slightly to the side. The silver AMG GT sits parked on wet dark asphalt. Man leans casually against the rear driver’s-side quarter panel, body relaxed, one hand resting on the car. Red taillights glow softly through the fog. Thick mist drifts slowly across the frame. Camera slowly dollies right and pushes in slightly. Soft focus on distant hills.

2.5–5.0s: Medium tracking shot as the man pushes off the car and walks slowly around the rear toward the driver’s door. Camera follows in a smooth lateral track, staying low. Fog thickens slightly. His dark silhouette contrasts against the pale misty sky.

5.0–7.5s: Medium close-up as he reaches the driver’s door. He places his hand on the flush door handle, opens the door with a smooth motion. Camera orbits slightly around him to the three-quarter front angle, revealing the long hood and illuminated headlights. Soft reflections of fog on the silver body.

7.5–9.5s: Interior over-the-shoulder as he settles into the driver’s seat. Dark luxurious cabin, ambient blue-purple lighting on the center console and air vents. He closes the door. Camera is low and intimate, showing the large digital screens and steering wheel with Mercedes star. Soft rain or condensation on the windshield.

9.5–11.0s: Extreme close-up of his hand reaching for and pressing the glowing red circular “S+” Sport Plus button on the center console. The button illuminates brighter. Subtle blue ambient light rings the controls. Shallow depth of field, focus racks slightly.

11.0–12.5s: Quick, sharp cut to extreme close-up of the dual rectangular exhaust tips at the rear of the car, slightly damp, with a soft metallic sheen. Fog drifting behind.

12.5–14.5s: Atmospheric cutaway – a lone black sheep walks slowly from left to right across a mossy green hill in thick fog, completely silhouetted. Soft grass in the foreground, almost abstract. Quiet, contemplative beat.

14.5–17.0s: Interior side profile as the car begins moving. Man’s face partially lit by dashboard glow, focused eyes looking ahead. His hand rests on the steering wheel. Through the side window, endless green hills and fog scroll past. Camera slowly pushes in on his profile.

17.0–19.5s: Dynamic exterior tracking shot from the passenger side, low and close to the body. Side mirror in foreground, the car carving smoothly along the winding wet mountain road. Hills and fog rush past. Slight motion blur on the background, car remains sharp. Cool blue-green color grade intensifies.

19.5–22.0s: Low angle looking up through the windshield from outside the car as it drives. Driver’s silhouette visible, two circular stickers on the glass. Foggy green mountains fill the background. Camera tracks with the car.

22.0–25.5s: Full interior dashboard POV shot looking forward. Hands firmly on the Alcantara steering wheel, digital cluster and large central navigation screen glowing (showing a winding road map). Through the windshield, the road curves through vibrant green hills disappearing into thick fog. Ambient purple and blue lighting on the vents and ceiling. Camera slightly handheld for realism, then stabilizes.

25.5–28.0s: Medium close-up profile of the driver as he drives. Strong hand on the wheel, subtle wristwatch visible. His expression is calm and locked-in. Outside the window, rocky green hillside and fog slide past. Soft rack focus from his face to the landscape. Final slow push-in as the car continues into the mist. Fade on the atmospheric green and teal tones.

Technical & Style Notes:
- Maintain consistent character face, clothing, and car design across every shot.
- Heavy volumetric fog with realistic light scattering.
- Wet road reflections and subtle water droplets on the car body.
- Smooth, professional camera moves only (dolly, track, orbit, gentle push-in). No shaky cam except very subtle handheld in interior driving shots.
- Color science: teal shadows, cool midtones, desaturated greens, warm skin tones only where lit by interior ambient light.
- High detail on car surfaces, fabric textures, facial features, and grass.
- Natural motion: realistic walking gait, door open, seating, steering inputs, and acceleration feel.
- Overall mood: solitary, powerful, meditative, luxurious performance in isolation.

Generate the full continuous sequence with seamless transitions between shots, perfect temporal consistency, and premium cinematic quality.

title: look at what Seedance 2.5 did with @alexmashrabov
text:
look at what Seedance 2.5 did with @alexmashrabov
the realism is insane. 7 days unlimited on Higgsfield

full prompt:

@Image1 is the absolute reference for THE RAPPER and completely replaces every previous performer reference. Preserve his exact identity: middle-aged man with a high receding hairline, short salt-and-pepper hair, thick dark eyebrows, dark eyes and a full beard with strongly defined white-gray sections. Preserve his stocky build, black-white-dark-green horizontally striped T-shirt with black chest pocket, sand-colored knee-length chino shorts and chunky off-white sneakers. No changes to his face, body, hair, beard, clothes or proportions.

A 30-second single continuous live stadium rap performance captured horizontally on an iPhone from the front audience section. Authentic handheld fan footage: physical hand tremor, operator breathing, imperfect reframing, rolling shutter, digital-zoom softness, momentary autofocus hunting and compressed phone-microphone sound. No cuts.

The first frame already shows THE RAPPER full-body on the right third at the end of a stage runway. A huge sold-out stadium surrounds him. Exactly four adult backup dancers wait several meters behind him. Emerald, white and black LED graphics echo the stripes of his shirt. The stage floor remains solid, flat and continuous.

A heavy original grime beat begins: deep sub-bass, dry kick, snapping snare and minimal low synth. The iPhone rapidly pinches from 1× to a shaky 5× digital zoom, briefly overshoots, then locks onto THE RAPPER in a full-body composition. Focus stays wide enough to preserve his feet and choreography.

He begins rapping with a low-mid, forceful cadence and exact lip synchronization:

THE RAPPER:
“Walk in steady, put the weight on the beat,
Every bar lands, every move stays clean.
Hands up high when the bass comes down,
I don’t chase the wave—I shake the whole ground!”

Only these words are spoken. Each line is delivered in one controlled breath.

On the first bar he performs two violent shoulder hits, a chest pop and a sharp forearm lock. His shirt and beard react naturally to momentum.

On the second bar he executes fast heel-toe pivots, crosses one foot behind the other and glides sideways while keeping his heavy body convincingly grounded. The camera operator struggles to keep his sneakers in frame, corrects downward and catches the complete footwork.

On the third bar the four dancers join in perfect synchronization. THE RAPPER leads a hard sequence: right stomp, left stomp, elbows strike outward, torso snaps backward, hands shoot overhead. Every movement lands precisely on a kick or snare.

The instrumental cuts for one beat. He holds a deep wide stance, eyes fixed on the upper tiers. His chest rises with one visible breath.

He shouts the final line while performing a rapid three-step, a controlled 180° pivot and one enormous downward arm strike. On “GROUND,” he stomps once. The bass returns with a massive impact; the LED floor sends a broad solid emerald light wave across the stage.

The entire stadium copies his movement. The phone shakes from thousands of spectators stomping together. He breaks into a confident grin but continues bouncing in time, pointing from one side of the stadium to the other.

The operator zooms rapidly back through 3× and 1× to 0.5× ultra-wide while turning 160° away from the stage in one continuous handheld sweep. Exposure briefly pumps, then recovers.

Finish on the full stadium bowl: tens of thousands of people across every tier performing the same shoulder-hit and stomp combination, emerald wrist lights moving in broad geometric waves, stage remaining on the far-left edge. Audio continues with the crowd chanting “SHAKE THE GROUND,” live bass vibration and realistic phone compression. Rich emerald and white light, warm skin and deep blacks. Clear air without haze, smoke, confetti, mist, sparks or airborne particles.

title: Seedance 2.5, a mythos level video model, is finally here. Coming soon to Higgsfield
text:
Seedance 2.5, a mythos level video model, is finally here. Coming soon to Higgsfield.

Here's the full prompt:

image_1 is the first frame. The woman from
image_1 — straight black hair, white short-sleeve collared shirt, navy pleated skirt, brown belt, braided bracelet — is holding the camera operator's hand and pulling him forward through the world. Camera is first-person POV, loose handheld, her hand visible in the lower right of frame gripping the operator's wrist, pulling. She walks ahead, glancing back over her shoulder occasionally. She walks, then runs, then sprints as the scale of the world gets bigger and more overwhelming. Every few seconds a vertical floor-to-ceiling insert appears ahead floating in open air — no border, no frame, no door, no arch, just a hard rectangular cut in space where one world ends and another begins — and she pulls him straight through it into the next world. Six locations total, one continuous uncut shot. Location 1 — 1970s apartment party interior from image_1: warm amber light, sequin curtain, strangers in background, she turns and pulls him out of the room forward. Location 2 — Petra, Jordan, midday: the narrow Siq canyon walls rising hundreds of meters on both sides, sunlight cutting down in a single strip, she runs pulling him through the corridor of ancient rock. Location 3 — Shibuya crossing, Tokyo, rush hour: hundreds of people crossing in every direction, she weaves pulling him through the crowd, neon signs and screens overhead in daylight. Location 4 — Sahara desert at golden hour: vast open dunes, no horizon line visible, wind moving the sand, she runs pulling him up a dune face, her skirt and hair flying. Location 5 — Venice, Italy, acqua alta flooding: St Mark's Square underwater, ankle-deep reflective water, pigeons displaced onto benches, she splashes forward pulling him across the flooded piazza. Location 6 — top of a mountain at dawn, clouds below: nothing ahead but open sky and light. She slows to a walk. Then stops. Still holding his hand. She turns and looks directly into the camera — directly at him — for the first time. Silence. Sound: party ambience fading, then canyon echo of running footsteps, then Tokyo crowd noise and distant traffic, then open desert wind, then Venice water splash and bells, then pure silence and wind at altitude. Her breathing gets heavier location by location. Style: photorealistic cinematic, 2.39:1 Cinemascope, warm film grain consistent across all six spaces, first-person handheld POV, one unbroken take from start to finish.

title: Seedance 2.5 直出 30 秒小短剧📺
text:
Seedance 2.5 直出 30 秒小短剧📺

【风格高概念脑洞喜剧短剧（High-concept Filter-Comes-Alive Comedy）🎬

prompt 👇

【风格】高概念脑洞喜剧短剧（High-concept Filter-Comes-Alive Comedy），真人实拍质感（Photorealistic）+ 滤镜版数字失真特效，抖音竖屏9:16爆款，居家暖光转门口强逆光，2人出镜(同一张脸的两种状态)
【时长】30秒
【场景】女生出租屋玄关，暖黄灯光，全身镜、口红外套挂钩，门口一开就是刺眼的白昼阳光
【角色】真人版她 @图1（自然素颜感：真实毛孔、淡淡黑眼圈、发型随意，好看但真实）、滤镜版她 @图1同一张脸（过度美颜：磨皮到发光、瞳孔放大、锥子下巴、浓密假睫毛、皮肤像塑料，动起来偶尔有数字残影）——两人同脸，靠"真实/失真"区分
【核心机制】滤镜版从手机屏幕里活出来，与真人抢着出门，最后在强光下滤镜崩坏"见光死"

[00:00-00:03] 钩子·屏幕里的她动了（怼脸手持自拍视角）
真人举着手机开满美颜疯狂自拍、嘟嘴比耶，然后放下手机准备去开门。手机屏幕里那个美颜版却没跟着放下——她自顾自托腮打了个哈欠，开口说话。
【台词】滤镜版（慵懒抱怨）：「哈——累死了，一直维持这个角度，你腮帮子不酸我酸。」

[00:03-00:06] 爬出手机（特写→中景）
真人吓得手机差点脱手。滤镜版扶着屏幕边框，像翻窗一样从手机里爬出来，落地伸个懒腰，浑身磨皮反光、假睫毛扇两下，数字残影一闪。

[00:06-00:09] 互相嫌弃（双人同框斗嘴）
滤镜版上下打量素颜真人，一脸嫌弃；真人也瞪着这个塑料脸的"自己"。
【台词】滤镜版（挑眉）：「就你这毛孔和黑眼圈也敢去见网友？今天，我去。」
她一把扯下挂钩上的外套。

[00:09-00:13] 门口拉扯（快节奏）
真人一把抢回外套，两人在玄关你拽我拉、互不相让，语速飞快。
【台词】真人：「他约的是我！」滤镜版：「他喜欢的是我这张脸！」

[00:13-00:16] 偷袭上位（反转铺垫）
门铃"叮咚"响。滤镜版趁真人分神，一把将她推到镜头外，自己迅速扶发、摆出完美角度，得意地去开门。

[00:16-00:20] 见光死（高能特效·全片核心）
门"唰"地拉开，刺眼的白昼阳光直射进来——滤镜版瞬间开始崩坏：脸忽大忽小、五官错位、皮肤打上马赛克、磨皮失灵露出诡异色块，整个人像信号极差的视频卡顿闪烁。
音效：一声刺耳的电流杂音+视频卡顿"嘟嘟"声。

[00:20-00:24] 网友后退（悬念处理）
门口来人(只给愣住的背影和后退半步的脚)被这鬼畜画面吓得倒退，一脸问号。滤镜版慌乱地想稳住脸，却越闪越离谱，发出机械故障音。

[00:24-00:27] 真人反杀
真人不慌不忙从旁边走进阳光里——素颜、真实、自然，反而在阳光下透亮好看。她一把拎起崩溃闪烁的滤镜版，像塞回垃圾桶一样把她按回手机屏幕里，拍拍手。

[00:27-00:30] 定格收尾
真人转头对门口的人自然一笑，阳光落在真实的脸上。
字幕（砸出）：「滤镜一时爽，见光就现形。」
音效：欢快BGM在滤镜崩坏时掐断留白，真人一笑时清爽音效"叮"，收尾。

【导演备注】1.创意机制铁律：两个女主必须是@图1同一张脸，靠"真实质感 vs 过度磨皮失真"强区分，绝不能长成两个人；滤镜版全程带极轻数字残影，为结尾崩坏埋线；2.见光死特效：滤镜崩坏只发生在门开、强光射入的瞬间，表现为马赛克/五官漂移/卡顿闪烁/塑料色块，像滤镜在强光下失效，是全片记忆点，前面不能提前崩；3.节奏铁律：屏幕说话→爬出→斗嘴→抢外套→偷袭→见光死→反杀一气呵成，每2-3秒一个新反应，不停顿；4.口型同步准确，斗嘴台词又快又冲；5.真人版结尾在阳光下要真实好看(不是丑)，立意是"真实>滤镜"，基调轻松不贬低任何人；6.门口来人只给背影/局部制造悬念，不露正脸。
【负面提示词】两个女主长成不同的人，真人版被拍丑/贬低身材，滤镜崩坏提前出现，见光死特效不明显，换脸(指两人互相变成别人)，口型不同步，表演僵硬夸张，塑料CG(除滤镜版故意的塑料感)，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面过度抖动，未成年人形象。

真人举着手机开满美颜疯狂自拍、嘟嘴比耶，然后放下手机准备去开门。手机屏幕里那个美颜版却没跟着放下——她自顾自托腮打了个哈欠，开口说话。
【台词】滤镜版（慵懒抱怨）：「哈——累死了，一直维持这个角度，你腮帮子不酸我酸。」

[00:03-00:06] 爬出手机（特写→中景）
真人吓得手机差点脱手。滤镜版扶着屏幕边框，像翻窗一样从手机里爬出来，落地伸个懒腰，浑身磨皮反光、假睫毛扇两下，数字残影一闪。

[00:06-00:09] 互相嫌弃（双人同框斗嘴）
滤镜版上下打量素颜真人，一脸嫌弃；真人也瞪着这个塑料脸的"自己"。
【台词】滤镜版（挑眉）：「就你这毛孔和黑眼圈也敢去见网友？今天，我去。」
她一把扯下挂钩上的外套。

[00:09-00:13] 门口拉扯（快节奏）
真人一把抢回外套，两人在玄关你拽我拉、互不相让，语速飞快。
【台词】真人：「他约的是我！」滤镜版：「他喜欢的是我这张脸！」

[00:13-00:16] 偷袭上位（反转铺垫）
门铃"叮咚"响。滤镜版趁真人分神，一把将她推到镜头外，自己迅速扶发、摆出完美角度，得意地去开门。

[00:16-00:20] 见光死（高能特效·全片核心）
门"唰"地拉开，刺眼的白昼阳光直射进来——滤镜版瞬间开始崩坏：脸忽大忽小、五官错位、皮肤打上马赛克、磨皮失灵露出诡异色块，整个人像信号极差的视频卡顿闪烁。
音效：一声刺耳的电流杂音+视频卡顿"嘟嘟"声。

[00:20-00:24] 网友后退（悬念处理）
门口来人(只给愣住的背影和后退半步的脚)被这鬼畜画面吓得倒退，一脸问号。滤镜版慌乱地想稳住脸，却越闪越离谱，发出机械故障音。

[00:24-00:27] 真人反杀
真人不慌不忙从旁边走进阳光里——素颜、真实、自然，反而在阳光下透亮好看。她一把拎起崩溃闪烁的滤镜版，像塞回垃圾桶一样把她按回手机屏幕里，拍拍手。

[00:27-00:30] 定格收尾
真人转头对门口的人自然一笑，阳光落在真实的脸上。
字幕（砸出）：「滤镜一时爽，见光就现形。」
音效：欢快BGM在滤镜崩坏时掐断留白，真人一笑时清爽音效"叮"，收尾。

【导演备注】1.创意机制铁律：两个女主必须是@图1同一张脸，靠"真实质感 vs 过度磨皮失真"强区分，绝不能长成两个人；滤镜版全程带极轻数字残影，为结尾崩坏埋线；2.见光死特效：滤镜崩坏只发生在门开、强光射入的瞬间，表现为马赛克/五官漂移/卡顿闪烁/塑料色块，像滤镜在强光下失效，是全片记忆点，前面不能提前崩；3.节奏铁律：屏幕说话→爬出→斗嘴→抢外套→偷袭→见光死→反杀一气呵成，每2-3秒一个新反应，不停顿；4.口型同步准确，斗嘴台词又快又冲；5.真人版结尾在阳光下要真实好看(不是丑)，立意是"真实>滤镜"，基调轻松不贬低任何人；6.门口来人只给背影/局部制造悬念，不露正脸。
【负面提示词】两个女主长成不同的人，真人版被拍丑/贬低身材，滤镜崩坏提前出现，见光死特效不明显，换脸(指两人互相变成别人)，口型不同步，表演僵硬夸张，塑料CG(除滤镜版故意的塑料感)，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面过度抖动，未成年人形象。

title: Testing Seedance 2.5 for an AI music video
text:
Testing Seedance 2.5 for an AI music video.

Japanese-inspired psychedelic abstract animation

Prompt: Core Style: Fast, vivid, unstable. Fully hand-drawn with rich organic textures. Every transition is fluid and natural—never rigid or mechanically cut. The entire frame, including the background, remains in constant motion, driven simultaneously by emotion, gravity, and heat. Every frame should feel alive, unpredictable, and physically reactive.

[0–7.5s: Origin and Chain Reaction]

[0–1.5s]

A central abstract figure erupts into violent motion. Its emotional color core radiates outward as irregular pulsating waves while its silhouette tears apart in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like compressed soft paper. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl rapidly across the entire frame, moving significantly faster than the figure itself, creating intense tension between body, skin, and surface.

[1.5–3s]

The separated contours accelerate into nervous linear forms. The figure's colorful core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains. Some ribbons snap backward while others whip violently forward, leaving trembling trails behind. Empty spaces between movements ignite into new forms that emerge to fill emotional voids.

[3–4.5s]

Every shape surges diagonally across the composition. One massive form folds like fabric, revealing layered textures of grain, chalk, wet ink, scratched paint, and rough pigment beneath its surface. The background folds together with it, twisting into entirely new color fields. Smaller forms are dragged into constantly evolving speed lines.

[4.5–6s]

The image fractures into four emotional forces: calm, violence, vulnerability, and ecstasy. Each absorbs color from the others. Shadows appear before their objects, behaving like prophecies. The original forms chase these shadows, but the shadows mutate faster—becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant until they surpass the objects themselves.

[6–7.5s]

A rapid chain reaction begins. Colliding forms generate visual motifs derived from the reference imagery: fragments, symbols, silhouettes, stains, and expressive linework. These newly born motifs accelerate in different directions. Frozen traces solidify into new entities before melting again and splitting into tiny emotional echoes.

---

[7.5–15s: Compression and Extreme Transformation]

[7.5–9s]

The entire frame collapses toward an invisible point beneath the center. Every visual layer compresses inward at a different speed. Maximum compression lasts for only one frame before exploding upward and outward with vertical smears, shaking outlines, and exaggerated overshoot motion. Every element vibrates before settling into a completely new position.

[9–10.5s]

Textures migrate between forms. Dry rough textures sharpen previously fluid shapes into angular structures. Liquid textures soften rigid forms until they sag and drip. Luminous colorful textures dissolve into the background, causing the environment itself to pulse rhythmically. Every object changes behavior according to the texture it inherits.

[10.5–12s]

A massive rotational force sweeps across the frame. Every form flips, inverts, or turns inside out, exposing hidden reverse sides possessing qualities of hands, hooks, flames, or waves. Every collision triggers escalating chain reactions, transforming the entire visual world into an entirely new emotional reality.

[12–13.5s]

All boundaries dissolve. Forms merge, repel, and merge again, generating hybrid entities that inherit the colors and movement of their predecessors while becoming completely different beings. The background pushes forward into the foreground, becoming part of the forms themselves while releasing new shapes from within.

[13.5–15s]

Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum intensity: contour separation, color bleeding, texture migration, and shadow-leading motion. Every frame is densely packed with intentional visual impact, fully absorbing and reinterpreting every reference element introduced earlier.

---

[15–22.5s: Fragmentation and Neurotic Storm]

[15–16.5s]

The storm collides with an invisible barrier. The center explodes into countless shards of water-covered broken glass. Within each fragment, glowing spiral irises rotate violently, generating centrifugal force that stretches and tears at the shard edges. Neon magenta and electric blue leak through every crack.

[16.5–18s]

The fragments fuse into overlapping collaged human faces. The faces are composed of purple stains, scratched paint, and rough pigment. Their expressions oscillate continuously between terror and ecstasy. Jagged lightning-like lines pierce through them like exposed nerve fibers, violently stitching the faces together.

[18–19.5s]

Color saturation reaches its peak. Electric blue lines solidify into physical cables stretching throughout space, twitching uncontrollably while releasing neon magenta sparks. The compressed paper background burns away, transforming into a charred, granular carbon-black surface.

[19.5–21s]

Gravity reverses. Liquid elements such as water droplets and wet ink surge upward while broken glass continues falling downward, producing intense visual tearing. Vertical smears appear along the edges of the frame as though an unseen force is physically wiping the entire animation off the canvas.

[21–22.5s]

Every form is pulled into countless miniature spiral-iris black holes. The irises rapidly expand until they dominate the entire screen, spinning at an increasingly suffocating speed. The rough tactile quality of chalk and dry brush textures contrasts violently against the brilliant electrical center, creating overwhelming sensory overload.

---

[22.5–30s: Aftershock and Eternal Echo]

[22.5–24s]

The giant iris evolves into pulsating biological tissue. The image breathes with a neurotic rhythm. Hidden symbols and textures appear and disappear beneath muscular contractions. Paint seepage creates convincing depth, as though layered across multiple transparent sheets of film.

[24–25.5s]

The animation enters an intense high-frequency vibration. Every object freezes in place while its edges oscillate violently like strings stretched to their breaking point. Violet shadows crawl across every surface, attempting to consume the remaining light.

[25.5–27s]

Rainbow-colored glass fragments and water droplets sweep across the frame like rain, refracting and distorting everything behind them through lens-like optical effects. Colors become heavy fluid masses that sink downward, leaving behind anxious, restless linear marks.

[27–28.5s]

The entire composition collapses into a single glowing horizontal jagged line. The background becomes a dark neon field filled with coarse grain. The line contains all accumulated energy, twisting violently while alternating flashes of electric blue and neon magenta pulse across it.

[28.5–30s]

The glowing line disintegrates into hand-drawn dust particles that drift rhythmically across the screen before gradually reassembling into one enormous blurred luminous silhouette. The final frame ends with tiny blocks of color continuing to vibrate subtly, leaving behind an everlasting emotional aftershock.

title: Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield
text:
Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield.

Prompt: Ultra-realistic 15-second selfie video of the exact woman from the reference image (precise facial structure, skin tone, hair, features, expression locked 1:1 — zero identity drift).
Setting: inside a luxury mansion living room. Marble columns, ornate white ceiling with detailed molding, large crystal chandelier, soft grey walls, elegant grey couch visible behind her. Background remains completely identical and static the entire time — no scene change, no camera movement beyond natural handheld micro-sway.
Camera: selfie mode, held close to her face, slightly wide lens (≈24-28mm equivalent). Natural indoor daylight coming from the front/side, soft and flattering. Extremely crisp focus on her face with shallow depth of field; background gently falls off. Handheld natural motion only.

Action sequence (strict timeline):
0.0–3.5s
She looks into the lens, warm genuine smile, and speaks clearly:
“Simbaaaa... simba come here... I'm making a video for Instagram, they wanna see you... good boy...”
3.5–7.0s
From behind the couch, a large fully realistic adult male lion slowly walks into frame. Soft, deliberate paw steps on the floor. Tail swaying gently. He sniffs the air as he approaches. He moves toward her right shoulder.
7.0–9.5s
She notices the lion over her shoulder, turns her head slightly, and laughs nervously while still holding the phone steady.
9.5–13.5s
The lion rubs his massive head against her cheek and neck exactly like a giant affectionate cat. Soft low growl/snort. Then he gently licks her face with a large realistic tongue.
She laughs genuinely and says:
“Aww good boy...”
13.5–15.0s
She continues smiling and laughing lightly as the lion stays close, nuzzling. Hold on the intimate interaction.
Extreme realism requirements:
Visible skin pores, fine facial hairs, natural micro-texture, subtle stubble if present in reference, realistic subsurface scattering and soft shadows on skin.
Lion: dense individual fur strands, accurate mane and body spots, realistic whiskers, wet black nose, detailed eyes, authentic tongue texture and saliva sheen when licking.
Natural physics on fur movement, weight, and contact.
Perfect facial consistency of the woman throughout - no morphing, no warping, no age/skin change.

Technical & style:
Ultra-sharp 8K detail, 64K micro-detail rendering, clean natural color grading, cinematic yet documentary realism, zero flicker, zero temporal warping, zero face distortion. Soft natural indoor light only.
Reference image locked for character identity.
